# Module `lune_ui_core::chrome`

[API reference](../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core`](index.md)

Tab chrome loop: one closed outline that wraps the active tab and the card body.

Port of the house look's tab chrome geometry (`BuildLoopFigure`), flattened to
a polyline. Card-local coordinates, logical pixels, y down. Clockwise on screen.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/chrome.rs:1`

The selected tab's span along the top edge, in logical px from the outline's left: the outline
leaves a notch between `left` and `right`.
